thread:
maya: Quick heads-up — running a small webinar + benchmark narrative workshop next Tue (seed session for webinar messaging). Need a tight playbook for inbound routing: separate demo requests from technical deep-dive leads. Agenda: 20m bench story, 20m claim pruning, 20m routing rules + SDR seeding. Who can join?

jon: I can do routing rules + SDR seeding. Want to test a two-tier routing idea: demo -> AE cohort, deep-dive -> Solutions Eng pool.

eli: Love two-tier. Also want to lock down the benchmark framing: 'serving-first econ' vs 'cloud-managed endpoints' — keep it punchy and measurable.

sara: I'll bring sample invite copy and webinar CTAs. We should keep a short technical CTA ("book a deep dive") and a product CTA ("request a demo").

alex: SDRs prefer one-sentence play scripts. Can you drop the CTAs here so I can mock up outreach?

maya: Draft CTAs: 1) "Request a demo — predictable latency & cost" 2) "Technical deep-dive — kernel/quantization details & benchmarks". Alex, want 2x line scripts?

alex: yes pls. Short scripts: 1) "Saw you registered for our webinar — want a quick demo of predictable latency?" 2) "We ran benchmarks for long-context agents — want a technical deep-dive with our infra leads?"

jon: For routing, propose simple intent tags on the registration form: `intent=demo` or `intent=deep`. Then a lightweight webhook to HubSpot to map to lists. Example rule we can test:```{
  "intent": "demo",
  "route": "ae-demo-list",
  "sla_hours": 24
}
{
  "intent": "deep",
  "route": "se-eng-list",
  "sla_hours": 48
}```Keep it minimal to reduce defects.

eli: Add a fallback: if capacity for SE is limited, route deep leads to a technical webinar follow-up queue with recorded session + schedule link. That preserves convo flow.

maya: Ops-bot — can you reserve the webinar slot in Calendly and post the registration link here? Also add a calendar event for the rehearsal.

ops-bot: Calendly link created: https://calendly.com/redwood/webinar-bench. Rehearsal event created for Mon 11am PT.

jon: One more ask — let's craft two benchmark soundbites for the slide deck: 1) "<2x latency vs default managed endpoints at 1k tokens" 2) "~35% lower per-token cost with prefix caching + continuous batching" — science team can validate numbers. Keep them conservative.

sara: I'll test three subject lines for the invite split test: A) "Webinar: serving-first benchmarks that cut cost" B) "How to make LLM inference predictable at scale" C) "Benchmarked: cost & latency tradeoffs for production LLMs" — will share results next week.

maya: Great. Action items: jon — routing webhook + sample rule json; alex — 2-line SDR scripts and inbox templates; sara — invite copy and subject tests; eli — lock benchmark phrasing with research; maya — run the claim pruning session in the workshop. Everyone in this thread please drop any one-liners or pokes for the slide deck by EOD Fri.

eli: Sending 2 conservative soundbites to this thread now.

alex: I'll seed 12 targeted accounts with the demo script after the rehearsal.

maya: Perfect — thanks team :thumbsup: 

sara: Quick note — include a short FAQ on routing expectations for sales to avoid dropped deep-dive requests.

jon: Agreed. I'll draft an FAQ snippet and post it before the workshop.

ops-bot: Reminder: rehearsal Mon 11am PT — link posted in calendar.
